oldGroup.title: A new library collection
oldGroup.passage: F1: Good afternoon. Before our repair workshop begins, I'd like to introduce the library's new tool collection. From next Monday, adult members can borrow household tools for up to seven days. The collection includes drills, sanders, and basic gardening equipment, but not ladders or large power saws. You can reserve an item online just as you would a book. However, tools must be collected from the ground-floor service desk rather than the self-service lockers. On your first visit, a staff member will demonstrate safe use and ask you to sign the lending form. Today's instructor will show you several items from the collection after the workshop. Please save your questions about reservations until then.
oldGroup.passageZh: 大家午安。修理工作坊開始之前，先介紹圖書館新的工具館藏。下星期一起，成年會員可借家用工具最多七天，包括電鑽、砂磨機及基本園藝工具，但不含梯子或大型電鋸。可以像預約書籍一樣在線上預約，但工具必須在一樓服務台領取，不能用自助取件櫃。第一次來時，館員會示範安全操作並請你簽借用表。今天的老師會在工作坊後展示幾件工具，關於預約的問題請留到那時再問。

oldQuestions.prompt: What new service is the library introducing?
oldQuestions.promptZh: 圖書館推出什麼新服務？

options.whyZh: 仍是在介紹借用，但不是書籍配送。
有園藝工具可借，未提供到府維護。
成年會員可借電鑽等家用工具最多七天。
有工作坊活動，沒有場地出租服務。

oldQuestions.prompt: What happens on a borrower's first visit?
oldQuestions.promptZh: 借用人第一次來會做什麼？

options.text: The borrower must purchase a tool.
options.whyZh: 這是借用服務，無購買要求。

options.text: The borrower receives a permanent locker.

options.whyZh: 七天是借用期限，不是訓練長度。

options.whyZh: 首次會示範安全使用並簽借用表。
